name: Hardy Adventurer
author: voodoo573
description: Feat from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. You can endure punishment that would break lesser beings. - Your maximum hitpoint total gains a bonus equal to twice your character level, increasing by 2 for each level you gain after taking this feat. - During a short rest, you regain 1 additional hit point per hit die spent to heal.
summary: Gain 2 extra hit points per character level and heal more when you spend Hit Dice.
